title: Quantum Entanglement in Multi-Photon Systems
abstract: We explore entanglement properties in multi-photon quantum systems using a novel measurement approach.

title: Deep Learning for Protein Structure Prediction
abstract: A neural network architecture is proposed to improve protein folding predictions using attention mechanisms.

title: Black Hole Mass Estimates from Gravitational Lensing
abstract: We present a new method for estimating black hole masses using strong gravitational lensing observations.

title: Graph-Based Algorithms for Efficient Routing
abstract: We introduce a graph optimization technique that reduces routing complexity in large-scale networks.

title: Self-Assembly of DNA Tiles Under Thermal Noise
abstract: This work analyzes the robustness of DNA tile self-assembly processes in the presence of thermal fluctuations.
